scripts.build:js: esbuild src/js/navigation.js src/js/book-single-gallery.js src/js/book-archive-toolbar-selects.js src/js/cf7-slim-select.js src/js/customizer.js src/js/lightbox.js --bundle --format=iife --outdir=assets/js --entry-names=[name].min --minify --target=es2018
scripts.watch:js: esbuild src/js/navigation.js src/js/book-single-gallery.js src/js/book-archive-toolbar-selects.js src/js/cf7-slim-select.js src/js/customizer.js src/js/lightbox.js --bundle --format=iife --outdir=assets/js --entry-names=[name].min --minify --target=es2018 --watch
scripts.watch: concurrently -n css,images,vendor,js "npm run watch:css" "npm run watch:images" "npm run watch:vendor" "npm run watch:js"
scripts.bundle: npm run build:css && npm run build:js && npm run build:images && npm run bundle:composer && node scripts/bundle.mjs
